Job Summary / Business Need


	The IT Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing IT operations and providing effective technical support.

	3&ndash;5 years of experience in end-user technical support.
	CompTIA A+.
	Microsoft Certified Modern Desktop Administrator and Google Platforms.

	Strong troubleshooting skills for laptops, desktops, printers, and scanners.
	Hands-on experience with Windows OS installation, configuration, and maintenance.
	Experience managing user accounts in Active Directory.
	Basic understanding of networking (LAN, Wi-Fi, DNS, VPN).


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@sevenup.org using the Job Position as the subject of the email.&nbsp;

IT Operations Manager Job at Seven Up Bottling Company




        
    

        
        Seven Up Bottling Company is one of the largest and oldest beverage manufacturing companies in Nigeria, operating nine automated bottling plants across the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: IT Operations Manager 

Job Location: Kano
Industry: FMCG

Job Summary / Business Need


	The IT Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing IT operations and providing effective technical support.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Provide frontline technical support for laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, and ERP systems to ensure minimal downtime and uninterrupted business operations.
	Oversee all IT-related activities at the site.
	Install, configure, and maintain end-user devices, including OS deployment, system upgrades, and hardware troubleshooting.
	Diagnose and resolve software, login, and Active Directory access issues.
	Support network and shared printers, including driver configuration and scan-to-email/folder troubleshooting.
	Provide first-line ERP support, resolving user access issues and transaction errors while escalating system bugs when necessary (SAP and other business applications).
	Manage user accounts, permissions, and email configuration (Google environment).
	Log and resolve incidents through a helpdesk system, ensuring SLA compliance and user satisfaction.
	Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues, including LAN, Wi-Fi, DNS, and VPN access.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience in end-user technical support.
	CompTIA A+.
	Microsoft Certified Modern Desktop Administrator and Google Platforms.
	ITIL Foundation (for service management environments).
	Strong troubleshooting skills for laptops, desktops, printers, and scanners.
	Hands-on experience with Windows OS installation, configuration, and maintenance.
	Experience managing user accounts in Active Directory.
	Basic understanding of networking (LAN, Wi-Fi, DNS, VPN).


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

Senior Data Engineer Job at Moniepoint




        
    

        
        Moniepoint Incorporated is a global business payments and banking platform and recently became QED Investors’ first investment in Africa. We are the partner of choice for over 600,000 businesses of all sizes, powering the dreams of SMBs and providing them with equal access to the tools they need to grow and scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Data Engineer 

Job Location: Remote

What you will get to do
     

            
    




	Build and maintain robust data pipelines processing large volumes of data
	Update and optimise our data platform for speed, scalability and cost
	Coordinate with different functional teams to understand and meet their data needs
	Develop processes and tools to monitor and analyse model performance and data accuracy
	Solve general data-related problems


To succeed in this role, you should have


	A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field
	Minimum of 5 years of proven experience as a Data Engineer
	Strong problem-solving skills
	Advanced proficiency with SQL
	Proficiency with Python
	Experience with cloud platforms (e.g. Google Cloud, AWS, Azure)
	Experience using version control tools such as git
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills
	A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques


Experience with the following would be a plus:


	Data governance
	Building and deploying machine learning models
	Terraform or other infrastructure as code tools


What we can offer you


	Culture -We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
	Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
	Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


	A take-home assessment 
	A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
	A technical interview with a Lead in our Engineering Team
	A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Head of Administration",
  "description": "Bradfield consulting is a professional service firm created to provide human resource solutions for organizations of any size. Our goal is to help our esteemed clients eliminate issues bordering on having incompatible or inexperienced employees. Our partnership begins from attracting the right employees, settling them well at work and ensuring that they are equipped to deliver on your goals.

Our culture of seamless collaboration enables us to go well beyond recruitment; we meet with every client, seeking to understand their needs and culture in a bid to engage the perfect candidate fit for them. This collaborative culture of problem-solving enables us to add great value to our clients businesses.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Head of Administration&nbsp;

Job Location: Abeokuta, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Education

Job Summary


	Provide strategic and operational leadership for all administrative, facilities and support services across the school.
	Ensure efficient, safe and compliant operational delivery that enables outstanding teaching, boarding and co?curricular provision. Lead continuous improvement of systems, processes and people to deliver value for money, strong risk management and excellent stakeholder service while supporting the Principal and Senior Leadership Team (SLT) in operational planning, budgeting and policy implementation.


Key Responsibilities
Strategic leadership and planning:


	Develop and implement a three? to five?year operational strategy and annual business plans for administration, facilities and support services aligned to the school&rsquo;s strategic objectives and boarding ethos.
	Provide input to whole?school strategic planning and senior leadership meetings, translating strategic priorities into operational objectives and measurable KPIs.
	Lead change and process improvement projects to increase efficiency, reduce cost and improve service delivery across administrative functions.


Operational management:


	Oversee day?to?day administrative operations including reception, office management, records and data management, communications, mail, travel and event logistics.
	Ensure robust records management for student, staff and corporate records in line with data protection law, inspection requirements and school policy.
	Manage school facilities and site operations: cleaning, security, catering liaison, grounds, maintenance, transport and utilities to deliver a safe, secure and welcoming environment for learners and staff.
	Lead health &amp; safety and emergency preparedness planning (fire safety, first aid, evacuation, crisis response), ensuring regular audits, risk assessments and staff training.


Financial and contract management:


	Prepare and manage operational budgets for administration, facilities and support services; monitor expenditure, drive cost control and provide timely financial reports to the Principal and governors.
	Lead procurement, contract negotiation and vendor management for services (catering, security, maintenance, ICT support, cleaning), ensuring value for money, compliance with procurement policy and robust SLAs.
	Oversee asset management, inventory control and lifecycle planning for equipment, furniture and vehicles.


Systems, compliance and policy:


	Implement, maintain and optimise core administrative systems including ERP/school management systems, finance and HR interfaces, facilities management software and CRM tools to deliver integrated workflows and accurate management information.
	Ensure compliance with statutory, inspection and accreditation requirements relevant to a British boarding school (safeguarding, health &amp; safety, fire regulations, local statutory requirements) and support preparation for inspections and audits.
	Lead development, review and implementation of operational policies and procedures (finance?related procedures, procurement, records retention, health &amp; safety, staff handbook), ensuring effective communication and adherence.


Staff leadership and human resources:


	Line?manage administrative, facilities, security, catering and support staff; set objectives, conduct performance appraisal, and deliver coaching and professional development.
	Lead recruitment, induction, rostering and workforce planning for support services; foster a culture of accountability, customer service and continuous improvement.
	Promote staff wellbeing, clear communication and constructive employee relations within support teams.


Stakeholder management and service delivery:


	Act as key operational point of contact for parents, staff, governors, external contractors and regulatory bodies; maintain high standards of customer service and timely communication.
	Support the Principal, SLT and governors with operational briefs, accurate data and recommendations for decision?making.
	Work closely with boarding and pastoral leads to ensure facilities and operational routines support boarding life, safeguarding, student welfare and learning.


Project and capital works management:


	Lead or oversee capital projects, refurbishments and major maintenance programmes from specification and tendering to contract management and handover.
	Ensure projects are delivered on time, to budget and to agreed quality standards, coordinating external consultants and contractors as required.
	Performance management and reporting
	Develop and maintain KPIs and performance dashboards for administrative areas (response times, maintenance turnaround, budget variance, compliance checks) and report monthly/termly to the principal and governors.
	Conduct periodic service reviews, supplier benchmarking and customer satisfaction surveys to drive improvement.


Requirements
Experience and qualifications:


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in business administration, Public Administration, Facilities Management or a related discipline; Master&rsquo;s Degree or professional qualification preferred.
	Minimum 15 years of relevant experience, with substantial senior operational / administrative leadership responsibility; experience in an international/British boarding school strongly preferred.
	Proven track record of managing large teams, multi?site facilities or complex service contracts.
	Strong IT literacy and experience with school ERP/management systems, finance packages and facilities management tools.
	Experience of leading capital projects, procurement processes and vendor management.
	Project Management experience is an added advantage.

        Bradfield consulting is a professional service firm created to provide human resource solutions for organizations of any size. Our goal is to help our esteemed clients eliminate issues bordering on having incompatible or inexperienced employees. Our partnership begins from attracting the right employees, settling them well at work and ensuring that they are equipped to deliver on your goals.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Head of Administration 

Job Location: Abeokuta, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Education

Job Summary


	Provide strategic and operational leadership for all administrative, facilities and support services across the school.
	Ensure efficient, safe and compliant operational delivery that enables outstanding teaching, boarding and co?curricular provision. Lead continuous improvement of systems, processes and people to deliver value for money, strong risk management and excellent stakeholder service while supporting the Principal and Senior Leadership Team (SLT) in operational planning, budgeting and policy implementation.


Key Responsibilities
Strategic leadership and planning:


	Develop and implement a three? to five?year operational strategy and annual business plans for administration, facilities and support services aligned to the school’s strategic objectives and boarding ethos.
	Provide input to whole?school strategic planning and senior leadership meetings, translating strategic priorities into operational objectives and measurable KPIs.
	Lead change and process improvement projects to increase efficiency, reduce cost and improve service delivery across administrative functions.


Operational management:


	Oversee day?to?day administrative operations including reception, office management, records and data management, communications, mail, travel and event logistics.
	Ensure robust records management for student, staff and corporate records in line with data protection law, inspection requirements and school policy.
	Manage school facilities and site operations: cleaning, security, catering liaison, grounds, maintenance, transport and utilities to deliver a safe, secure and welcoming environment for learners and staff.
	Lead health & safety and emergency preparedness planning (fire safety, first aid, evacuation, crisis response), ensuring regular audits, risk assessments and staff training.


Financial and contract management:


	Prepare and manage operational budgets for administration, facilities and support services; monitor expenditure, drive cost control and provide timely financial reports to the Principal and governors.
	Lead procurement, contract negotiation and vendor management for services (catering, security, maintenance, ICT support, cleaning), ensuring value for money, compliance with procurement policy and robust SLAs.
	Oversee asset management, inventory control and lifecycle planning for equipment, furniture and vehicles.


Systems, compliance and policy:


	Implement, maintain and optimise core administrative systems including ERP/school management systems, finance and HR interfaces, facilities management software and CRM tools to deliver integrated workflows and accurate management information.
	Ensure compliance with statutory, inspection and accreditation requirements relevant to a British boarding school (safeguarding, health & safety, fire regulations, local statutory requirements) and support preparation for inspections and audits.
	Lead development, review and implementation of operational policies and procedures (finance?related procedures, procurement, records retention, health & safety, staff handbook), ensuring effective communication and adherence.


Staff leadership and human resources:


	Line?manage administrative, facilities, security, catering and support staff; set objectives, conduct performance appraisal, and deliver coaching and professional development.
	Lead recruitment, induction, rostering and workforce planning for support services; foster a culture of accountability, customer service and continuous improvement.
	Promote staff wellbeing, clear communication and constructive employee relations within support teams.


Stakeholder management and service delivery:


	Act as key operational point of contact for parents, staff, governors, external contractors and regulatory bodies; maintain high standards of customer service and timely communication.
	Support the Principal, SLT and governors with operational briefs, accurate data and recommendations for decision?making.
	Work closely with boarding and pastoral leads to ensure facilities and operational routines support boarding life, safeguarding, student welfare and learning.


Project and capital works management:


	Lead or oversee capital projects, refurbishments and major maintenance programmes from specification and tendering to contract management and handover.
	Ensure projects are delivered on time, to budget and to agreed quality standards, coordinating external consultants and contractors as required.
	Performance management and reporting
	Develop and maintain KPIs and performance dashboards for administrative areas (response times, maintenance turnaround, budget variance, compliance checks) and report monthly/termly to the principal and governors.
	Conduct periodic service reviews, supplier benchmarking and customer satisfaction surveys to drive improvement.


Requirements
Experience and qualifications:


	Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, Public Administration, Facilities Management or a related discipline; Master’s Degree or professional qualification preferred.
	Minimum 15 years of relevant experience, with substantial senior operational / administrative leadership responsibility; experience in an international/British boarding school strongly preferred.
	Proven track record of managing large teams, multi?site facilities or complex service contracts.
	Strong IT literacy and experience with school ERP/management systems, finance packages and facilities management tools.
	Experience of leading capital projects, procurement processes and vendor management.
	Project Management experience is an added advantage.


Required Skills and attributes:


	Proven senior leadership capability in school operations, facilities and administrative management within an international, British curriculum or boarding school environment.
	Demonstrable experience implementing and optimising ERP/school management systems and office technology to automate processes and improve data quality.
	Robust understanding of safeguarding, health & safety, emergency planning and compliance frameworks relevant to UK and local Nigerian regulation.


Benefits


	Housing, health insurance for family, pension, leave allowance and 13th month pay, lunch.
	Salary: N1,000,000 – N1,100,000 monthly gross (negotiable).
